item.storynpcs.npc_wand.tooltip.1: Right-click a block: create an NPC and open its editor
item.storynpcs.npc_wand.tooltip.2: Right-click an NPC: edit it · Left-click an NPC: remove it
item.storynpcs.npc_cloner.tooltip.1: Right-click an NPC: copy it as a template
item.storynpcs.npc_cloner.tooltip.2: Right-click a block: stamp a copy
item.storynpcs.npc_path.tooltip.1: Right-click an NPC to select it, then right-click blocks to add waypoints
item.storynpcs.npc_path.tooltip.2: Sneak + right-click air: clear the path
item.storynpcs.npc_mounter.tooltip.1: Right-click an entity, then right-click another to mount them
item.storynpcs.npc_dialogue_wand.tooltip: Right-click an NPC: open its dialogue editor (creates one if needed)
item.storynpcs.nbt_book.tooltip.1: Right-click an entity: view its NBT
item.storynpcs.nbt_book.tooltip.2: Ops can edit allowlisted fields · everything else is read-only
item.storynpcs.npc_teleporter.tooltip.1: Right-click an NPC to select, then a block to move it there
item.storynpcs.npc_remover.tooltip.1: Click an NPC twice to despawn it (definition preserved)
item.storynpcs.npc_soulstone.tooltip.1: Click an NPC twice to capture its binding, then a block to redeploy
